title: 蘭亭修禊圖（1977.47）
holder: 克利夫兰美术馆（藏品号 1977.47）
medium: Handscroll; ink and color on silk
one_line: 克利夫兰美术馆藏画作，馆方断代作「1671」。**本条为著录级**：照录馆方记录，未作阐释。

rows: Handscroll; ink and color on silk
Gift of Mrs. Wai-kam Ho and the Womens Council of The Cleveland Museum of Art

basics.text: **本条为著录级条目。**以上各项照录克利夫兰美术馆的藏品记录，字段名标明「馆方」者即其原文。本库尚未对其作独立核校，亦未就断代、归属、风格作任何判断——分期归入依据仅为：朝代名 → qing；器类归入依据仅为：type=Painting。

items: Ho, Wai-kam, Sherman E. Lee, Laurence Sickman, and Marc F. Wilson. Eight Dynasties of Chinese Painting: The Collections of the Nelson Gallery-Atkins Museum, Kansas City, and the Cleveland Museum of Art. Cleveland, OH: Cleveland Museum of Art, in cooperation with Indiana University Press, 1980.（Reproduced: cat. no. 218, pp. 287–288）
Williams, Marjorie. Chinese Painting--an Escape from the "Dusty" World. Cleveland, OH: The Cleveland Museum of Art, 1981.（Reproduced:  fig. 26, p. 42）
Graham, Patricia Jane. Tea of the Sages: The Art of Sencha. Honolulu: University of Hawaiʻi Press, 1998.（p. 51, no. 8）
Chan Tat Chuen, William. A la table de l'empereur de Chine. Arles: Éditions Philippe Picquier, 2002.（pp. 34-35）
Li, T. June. Another World Lies Beyond: Creating Liu Fang Yuan, the Huntington's Chinese Garden. San Marino, CA: Huntington Library, 2009.（p. 70）
**馆方记录另有 3 条著录未在此列出。**

dating.text: 馆方著录中有含纪年的款识（见「题跋与鉴藏」一节），其年份与馆方断代一致，故断代依据可以填「款识」而不再是无从得知。**只给「较可靠」不给「确证」**：本库未核对原件，款识本身的真伪、是否后添均未独立判定。
款识原文未经本库目验；馆方亦未说明其对该款识真伪的判断。

colophons.text: Artist's inscription, signature, and 2 seals: Painted by Fan Yi of Zhongfu during the second month of winter of the xinhai year [1671]. [2 seals] Fan Yi zhi yin, Zi yu yi.
Title on the frontispiece by Monk Yueshan (1629–1709).
以上为克利夫兰美术馆藏品记录里的题跋与钤印著录，**本库未核对原件**；款印的真伪、题跋者身份与年代均未独立判定。

provenance.text: Tomioka Tessai 富岡鐵齋 [1837–1924], Kyoto, Japan
Wong Kwan-Shut 黃君實 [b. 1934], Kansas City, Missouri, sold to the Cleveland Museum of Art
The Cleveland Museum of Art, Cleveland, OH
以上递藏链照录自馆方档案。**本库未独立核实其中任一环节**；经手人身份、交易性质与时间点均以馆方记录为准，本库不据此判定流散性质。
